content.text: Accessibility Tools Skip to main content Brian C. Gutierrez Brian C. Gutierrez is a trial lawyer who has stood on the side of working Texas families since 2006,— representing clients in College Station, Bryan, TX, and the surrounding areas. Mr. Gutierrez has tried cases in front of a jury in every county and district court in Brazos County. Brian’s Background Brian C. Gutierrez was born in Laredo, Texas. He studied political science and history and earned his undergraduate degree from Texas A&M University in College Station in 2003. He received a Bachelor of Science with honors, finishing with a perfect 4.0 in his major. He attended The University of Texas School of Law, one of the top law schools in the country, and graduated in 2006. While in law school, Mr. Gutierrez worked for a boutique firm in Austin, Texas. Today, Mr. Gutierrez enjoys a storied relationship with his community, having spent the last 17 years fighting on behalf of those who deserve it most. As a board-certified personal injury lawyer whose practice covers the full breadth of personal injury cases, Brian has established himself as a tough negotiator who will not hesitate to bring matters before a judge if necessary. For Mr. Gutierrez, personal injury advocacy isn’t just a job…it’s a passion. Memberships and Affiliations Board Certification in Personal Injury Trial Law—Texas Board of Legal Specialization The Million-Dollar Advocates Forum The Multi-Million-Dollar Advocates Forum The American Board of Trial Advocates (ABOTA) The Bryan/College Station Chapter of ABOTA Texas Bar Foundation The Texas Trial Lawyers Association (TTLA) The American Association for Justice (AAJ) College of the State Bar of Texas Pro Bono College of the State Bar of Texas The American Bar Association The National Trial Lawyers The Local Brazos County Bar Association Advocating for Justice The vast majority of Mr. Gutierrez’s cases are referred to him by his clients, colleagues, and former judges. Mr. Gutierrez is licensed in every state court of Texas and in both the Western and Southern Districts of Texas. Mr. Gutierrez is also board-certified in personal injury law, a distinction granted to fewer than 2% of all attorneys in the state of Texas. When defending his clients, Brian’s mission is always to relentlessly uncover the truth. He understands that a payout is good, but that one motivated by truth and justice is even better. He approaches every case with his client’s total support in mind so they can focus on rest and recovery while Brian and his team go to war on their behalf. Brian C. Gutierrez and his team treat every client like a member of their family…and nobody messes with family. His impressive record for success arises from his distinct ability to not just out-work but out-care his opponents. If you’d like to learn more about how Mr. Gutierrez can help you, reach out to his offices and set up your consultation today. “No words describe how amazing it is to work with Brian.” J.T. Our Commitment To Your Case No one will work harder for you. No one will care more.
